# GitHub Pull Request Template

## Description

Brief summary of the changes in this PR.

## Type of Change

- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (fixes an issue without changing features)
- [ ] ✨ Feature (adds new functionality)
- [ ] 📚 Documentation (adds or updates docs)
- [ ] 🎨 Refactor (restructures code without behavior change)
- [ ] ⚡ Performance (improves speed or efficiency)
- [ ] 🧪 Tests (adds or updates tests)
- [ ] 🔧 Chore (build, CI/CD, deps, etc.)

## Related Issues

Closes #(issue)

## Changes Made

- Change 1
- Change 2
- Change 3

## Testing

How have you tested these changes?

- [ ] Unit tests added/updated
- [ ] Tested locally
- [ ] Manual testing performed

## Checklist

- [ ] Code follows project style guidelines
- [ ] Markdown files pass linting (200 char line limit, GFM)
- [ ] Tests pass (`pnpm test`)
- [ ] Type checking passes (`pnpm check:types`)
- [ ] No console errors or warnings
- [ ] Commit messages are clear and follow conventions
- [ ] Changes fit the code review scope
